summary: Publish OMP channel readiness diagnostics only on durable per-incarnation transitions

replay.detail: The native observation outbox freezes each readiness edge decision before HTTP. Lost acknowledgements and wrapper re-exec retry the same event-keyed claim; unchanged readiness events do not publish another diagnostic. Both readiness edges and the first ready of a new harness incarnation remain visible, including within an unchanged wrapper runtime.

schema.detail: Uses existing local outbox metadata and prepared slots. No database version, replicated claim schema, or client-v0 changes.

rules.detail: Readiness diagnostics remain replicated because idle suspension and residency consume their latest per-incarnation edge. No retention or checkpoint digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing readiness readers consume the same codes and fields, without requiring periodic refreshes. Non-durable publishers retain their original episode-based readiness idempotency and continue publishing activity.

downtime.detail: Ordinary binary rollout; no coordinated migration.

manual.detail: No operator action. Missing or invalid readiness metadata emits a diagnostic rather than suppressing it.

recovery.detail: Ordinary rollback restores the previous publication behavior. Existing local outbox tables remain compatible.
